questions.title: A few things you might be wondering.
questions.description: Here are the basics. For anything else, get in touch with us.

items.question: Who is Lab Lords for?
items.answer: Lab Lords helps owners and staff at reading libraries, study halls, coaching centres and tuition centres manage students, seats, shifts and fee records.

items.question: Do I need a card for the trial?
items.answer: No. Eligible new owners get one 30-day Standard trial after setting up their first branch. The trial is shared across branches in that workspace. Adding branches does not extend it.

items.question: Can I add my existing student list?
items.answer: Yes. You can enter students individually or use spreadsheet import. Review your information and resolve any flagged issues before confirming an import.

items.question: Can I manage more than one branch?
items.answer: Yes. Each branch keeps its own operational records. Pricing is per billable branch per month, so the total depends on your plan and billable branch count.

items.question: Can my staff use Lab Lords?
items.answer: Standard includes staff invitations and permission controls. Your staff see the branch information and actions they are allowed to access.
